contrasts[0].question: Whose table did the picanha come back to? It left the speech — but with 82 in every 100 families in debt, did it leave the budget too?
contrasts[1].question: The lowest unemployment on record and 16.6 million people who need more work are the same country. Which of the two numbers makes it into the speech?
contrasts[2].question: The worker's US$ 50 top paid 44.6%; the bank shareholder's dividend paid zero for three decades. Which of the two was zeroed in 2026?
contrasts[3].question: The speech celebrated 5.8 million jobs created. In the two years that followed, unemployment nearly doubled. How many Brazilians heard the promise and lost their job?

verifiedNote: Checked receipt by receipt on 23 August 2026. Two defects fixed: household debt started from '78% in Dec 2022', a figure the cited article does not carry — the documented endpoint is 78.9% in Nov 2022, and 78% was never the 2022 record (October that year hit 79.2%). And the 38.1% informality rate pointed to the QUARTERLY article, which says 37.5%; 38.1% is the 2025 annual average and now points to the IBGE annual release.
